description: Yields tuples of `n` items and a shorter last tuple, reading only enough input to fill each batch (Python 3.12).
Starts a new group each time the key changes, so unsorted input gives runs rather than totals per key.
Yields running results of a binary function, addition by default; `initial` adds a leading value.
Yields overlapping pairs of adjacent items from any iterable (Python 3.10).
Splits one iterator into independent ones by buffering items, at a memory cost when consumers drift apart.
